report.title: Engineering the Eviulon Commonwealth Library Corpus: A Framework for Ethical, High-Fidelity Language Model Pretraining
report.summary: The curation of the Eviulon Commonwealth Library into a machine-learning training corpus represents a highly specialized data engineering challenge.
